svg.title: Auto belay
svg.desc: A top-mounted circular housing with a downward nozzle pays out webbing. The connector clips to the harness belay loop only, gate facing away from the user.
svg.text: Webbing retracts as you climb and lowers when weighted. Clip the connector to the belay loop only.
Housing at the top of the wall
flat line, not a climbing rope
retracts as the climber goes up
clips to the belay loop only
gate facing away from the user
do not clip multiple hard points
the attachment point on the harness
TRUBLUE and Head Rush: clip to the belay loop only; gate facing away from the user; do not clip multiple hard points. Perfect Descent: wear-indicating webbing lanyard to a self-locking carabiner.
The housing is a generic circular body with a top mount and bottom nozzle (the shape shared by TRUBLUE Speed and Perfect Descent diagrams). Maker marks and internal brakes are omitted.
